opening: Describe the inspected opening frame and framing.
action: Describe playback inspection of the readable action.
ending: Describe the inspected ending / clean cut boundary.
identity: Check silhouette, anatomy, wardrobe, markings and color; for the cup check rim, handle, glaze streak.
motion: Check motion through playback; still frames alone cannot establish motion quality.
continuity: Compare with the selected reference and adjacent shot; record any mismatch.
audio: State whether sound/dialogue was played and checked, absent, or still needs user review.

dialogue_checks.notes: For configured dialogue, set applicable=true after playback and replace every pending value. Use the runner-derived expected first word; actual_first_word_speaker must equal dialogue.speaker; listener_silent and exact_text must be true. Review first 1-2 seconds, complete line and last second (minimum recorded durations: opening 1.0 s, ending 0.5 s). evidence_source must be agent_playback or user_playback. Replace this instruction with concrete observations, timestamps and any exact scoped user response. A listener saying any opening word fails. For non-dialogue, leave applicable=false and explain why. Stills/audio presence alone cannot pass these checks.
